# Protocol Checklist: The session never acts on a frame it could not parse

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the session-layer disposition of framed-but-unparseable frames (C-2 rows, sequence accounting, Reject contents, the inbound seqnum_max bound) against FIX-SL 2020 and the 2026-09-27 owner ruling on fixpp#507.
**Created**: 2026-09-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [contract](../contracts/unparseable-frame-disposition.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is a disposition defined for every combination of session state (NotConnected, LogonSent, LogonReceived, Active, LogoutSent, AwaitingResend), field-3-is-35, 34-read and MsgType class, with no combination falling through the C-2 table? [Completeness, Contract §C-2]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the set of `hdr` fields a disposition may read on a faulty frame enumerated exhaustively (34, 35, the field-3 bit, and the fault kind / Length tag for the reason code), with every other field excluded? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Contract §C-3 I-1]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the Reject's field values (45, 372, 373, 371, 58) specified for every Reject row, including when 372 is omitted and when 371 is omitted? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-007, Contract §C-2]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the disposition of a faulty frame during AwaitingResend specified for each row, including a faulty GapFill (C-5 L-2) and a faulty in-sequence application message that fills the gap? [Completeness, Contract §C-2, §C-5 L-2]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the late parse sites defined by a derivation (command plus classification rule) rather than a list, and is the single action at every site fully specified (close mode, no Reject, which callback is suppressed)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, Contract §C-6]
- [ ] CHK006 Is every `check_inbound` caller's disposition of `store_seqnum_overflow` specified, including the return value of `on_inbound_frame` at Guard 4? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, Research §R-14]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the effects a late close cannot undo (Guards 2–3, the Guard 4 advance, the resend-gap close, liveness, the confirming Logout) listed, so no requirement implies they are rolled back? [Completeness, Contract §C-6]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the replay classification of a stored frame whose scan read no 35 specified, with its fail-safe outcome (gap-fill, never resend)? [Completeness, Research §R-12]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 Is "34 read" defined precisely enough to classify `34=abc`, `34=0`, a 34 straddling the fault, and a duplicate 34 before the fault? [Clarity, Data-model §E-1, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "field 3 is 35" defined for the case where field 3 is itself the faulting field, and where the scan faults before field 3? [Clarity, Data-model §E-1, Contract §C-2]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the "failure point" defined as a byte position with an unambiguous rule for which fields lie "wholly before" it? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "disregard" defined as one named disposition and used with exactly that meaning everywhere (no Reject, no advance, no disconnect, no liveness refresh)? [Clarity, Spec §Terminology, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the term "garbled" reserved for the four §4.5.2 framing criteria across spec, plan, contract and B&L text, with "framed but unparseable" used for 092's input? [Clarity, Spec §Terminology]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "the message would consume NextNumIn" defined by predicate (Guard 4, a #423 site, D-5, a pre-Active Logon), with the non-consuming cases named? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities, Contract §C-5 L-7]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the 372 bound defined by derivation from the shipped dictionaries rather than by a literal, with the omission rule stated? [Clarity, Research §R-5]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK016 Do FR-003–FR-006 and the C-2 row order agree for every case, including a faulty Reject(3) or Logout(5) and a faulty Logon while Active? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003–§FR-006, Contract §C-2]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the supersession of the no-reject-loop rule scoped identically in spec FR-003, contract C-2, the Edge Cases and the planned `admin_messages.hpp` text (faulty frames only; well-formed Reject/Logout keep the exemption)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Contract §C-2]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the pre-Active rules (D-1/D-2 refuse whatever field 3 is) consistent with FR-008, FR-009 and the deferral of the pre-Active disregard to fixpp#514? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK019 Do FR-019's precedence over FR-003/FR-004 at seqnum_max and FR-013's persist-before-Reject ordering produce one unambiguous outcome for D-5 at seqnum_max? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the FR-018 liveness rule consistent between Active and LogonReceived, and between the Reject rows and the disregard rows? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018, Contract §C-2]
- [ ] CHK021 Is `fault_ref_msg_type` (never the last-wins `msg_type`) the value named in every place that decides a row or fills 372? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Contract §C-2]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements stated for a faulty frame whose MsgSeqNum is below expected, above expected, and equal to expected, each with and without PossDupFlag=Y? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §C-2 D-6]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the outcome defined for a faulty frame carrying a wrong CompID or BeginString before the fault? [Edge Case, Spec §Clarifications Q2]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the precedence of the MaxMessageSize(383) guard over the disposition stated for an oversized faulty frame? [Edge Case, Contract §C-1 step 1b]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the reason code defined when a frame has more than one malformed field? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the resend-loop behaviour of the disregard rows disclosed as an outcome rather than left implicit? [Coverage, Contract §C-5 L-1, Spec §A-5]
- [ ] CHK027 Is a bound stated on the Reject exchange between two peers that each reject faulty Rejects? [Coverage, Contract §C-2 "A loop is bounded"]
- [ ] CHK028 Are the seqnum_max outcomes defined for every store kind, with the non-persistence of the SequenceReset jump stated as the reason both kinds behave alike? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019, Research §R-14]

## Conformance & Traceability

- [ ] CHK029 Is each departure from FIX-SL 2020 and its test cases recorded with its source (TC2020 17d's 373=8, the §4.5.2 disregard of Framer failures, TC 2d/3b/3c terminal handling)? [Traceability, Contract §C-5 L-4, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the owner ruling (and its correction comment on #507) cited as the authority for the #423 row 4 revision, with the revised row stated? [Traceability, Spec §Context]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the absence of a FIX.4.x / FIXT.1.1 difference and of a configuration switch stated as a requirement with a witness matrix? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, Contract §C-3 I-6]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the scope boundary with fixpp#514 (framing disregard, fault-free field 3 not 35, establishment timeout) and fixpp#515 (resource disposition) stated in one place and referenced consistently? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions]
